summary: Nexxen International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Proxy Statement for a meeting scheduled September 29, 2026. Agenda items include re-election of five directors, ratification of independent auditors (Kost Forer Gabbay Kasierer, an Ernst & Young member), an increase in share reserves under equity compensation plans, approval of CEO compensation, and consideration of audited financial statements for fiscal year 2025. Record date is August 24, 2026. This is a routine annual meeting notice with no special-situation transaction, no premium, no deal terms, and no strategic action; it is a standard governance and compensation approvals event.
